title: Stay Connected Across Borders with Remitly Global Card Travel eSIM
summary: Remitly Global Card customers get a travel eSIM with mobile data in 160+ countries—no roaming fees, no local SIM needed.
body_markdown:
From the moment you land in a new country, staying connected should be fast and flawless so that you can manage your money, navigate your destination, and stay in touch with the people who matter.


That’s why the Remitly Global Card membership includes a 3GB global travel eSIM, giving eligible cardmembers mobile data across 160+ countries. Once activated the eSIM works as soon as you land, so there’s no need to purchase a local SIM card, worry about roaming fees, or search for Wi-Fi just to get connected.


The travel eSIM renews every year with membership and the 3GB is available to use over a 12-month period. Need more? Top up instantly from your phone. Getting started takes seconds, requires no physical SIM card, and works natively on iPhone and Android devices.


It’s a feature that helps solve a challenge for people living global lives. Whether you’re traveling for work, visiting family, studying abroad, or moving between countries, the travel eSIM is designed to make one of the first parts of any trip easier: getting online.


The travel eSIM is part of the broader Remitly Global Card, a card built for people whose lives extend across borders. Cardmembers can use one account to spend, save, send money, and get paid, with features designed around the realities of living and traveling internationally.


The Remitly Global Card is for wherever life takes you.


*The Remitly Global Card is available today to eligible, invited customers, with the Card’s regional rollout expanding globally through the remainder of 2026. Haven’t been invited yet? Join the waitlist at*[remitly.com/cards](http://remitly.com/cards) *.*


*Travel eSIM is provided by Gigs, Wireless, LLC. Requires eligible customers with an active, paid Remitly Global Card Monthly Plan membership and an eSIM-compatible, carrier-unlocked device.*
